name: Volatile Aerosol Catalytic Charge VACC-6
description:
The VACC-6 is a delayed-action area weapon that operates through catalytic aerosol chemistry rather than conventional explosive mechanics. The device releases a proprietary suspended catalyst compound — developed under LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS' advanced biochemical division — that remains inert in open air but undergoes rapid exothermic oxidation when it contacts the compressed, humidified air of sealed respiratory systems: lungs, rebreathers, HVAC circulation loops, and sealed habitat environments. The resulting reaction is not a traditional explosion but a localized chemical combustion event occurring at the point of inhalation or intake, typically producing severe internal thermal trauma and toxic oxidation byproducts simultaneously.

The tactical novelty of the VACC-6 is its discrimination logic: the catalytic compound is essentially harmless in ambient atmospheric conditions but becomes a precision incendiary the moment it enters a system designed to concentrate and circulate air. This makes it extraordinarily effective in environments where conventional explosives cannot be used — pressurized habitats, clean-room facilities, medical bays, and sealed transport vehicles. Targets wearing open-face armor survive unharmed while those in sealed suit systems suffer catastrophic respiratory failure. The compound disperses to safe concentrations within 90 minutes in open environments.

LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS has consistently denied that the VACC-6 was developed as a weapons system, characterizing the catalytic compound as a derivative of their atmospheric remediation research. Internal documents recovered by investigative journalists suggest otherwise. The weapon is called 'Breathseed' by operators because of the delay between dispersal and effect — you plant it in the air, and it grows when someone breathes.
specifications:
dispersal radius: 12m initial cloud
activation condition: Contact with compressed/humidified respiratory airflow
reaction temperature: 600–900°C at point of contact
atmospheric persistence: 90 minutes at standard conditions
compound state: Suspended nano-droplet aerosol
delivery form: Pressurized canister, 380g
weight: 0.6 kg
safe handling: Open-air deployment only; deploying operator must use open-face respirator, not sealed system
detection: Requires specialized spectrographic analysis; invisible, odorless
tactical_use: Used for covert facility denial — deployed in HVAC intake points, airlock staging areas, and pressurized vehicle garages before target arrival. Particularly effective against sealed-suit security teams and environmental control personnel who rely on closed-loop air systems. Assassination applications involve trace dispersal in enclosed vehicles or private habitat spaces. The 90-minute dissipation window allows operators to be long clear of the site before effects manifest, providing deniability. Counter-use: targets who detect the compound via spectrographic scan have a brief window to purge affected systems.
cultural_context: The VACC-6 is one of the most controversial weapons in GLMZ's black market ecosystem because of its perceived 'invisibility' — it leaves no blast signature, no shrapnel, no obvious crime scene. LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS' corporate reputation has been shadowed by persistent rumors of its involvement in several high-profile sealed-facility deaths, none of which have been conclusively prosecuted. Among covert operators, Breathseed is considered a mark of serious professional resources — it is not a weapon for street-level violence but for the kind of targeted elimination that makes bodies look like accidents.
known_users: High-end fixers with access to tier-5 procurement channels
Rogue pharmaceutical researchers selling to private clients
story_hooks: A sealed-habitat executive dies of apparent respiratory failure — the party is hired by his family, who suspect VACC-6 but can find no evidence because the compound has long since dissipated.
LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS approaches the party to recover stolen research files — the files contain the synthesis protocol for the VACC-6 compound, and someone is already selling copies.
The party's safehouse has been hit with a VACC-6 dispersal — they have 90 minutes to figure out who targeted them before the compound clears and evidence disappears.

A whistleblower from LAZARUS claims the compound has a secondary, undocumented effect: long-term trace accumulation in non-sealed environments that can be activated remotely by a specific radio frequency.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, cylindrical pressurized canister with a distinctly pharmaceutical aesthetic — clinical and deliberately non-threatening in appearance. The form evokes an aerosol dispenser or compressed gas cartridge rather than a weapon, with smooth curves and a tapered nozzle. The design is intentionally ambiguous: it could pass cursory inspection as a legitimate medical or industrial aerosol product.
physical_description.dimensions: Height: 18 cm, diameter: 6.5 cm, nozzle protrusion: 2 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Compact and deceptively light in hand — 600 grams feels almost negligible, creating a false sense of innocuousness. The weight distribution is balanced toward the center, making it easy to palm or conceal in a jacket pocket.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy body with a polycarbonate pressure-relief cap. The internal chamber uses a specialized inert polymer coating to prevent premature catalytic degradation.
physical_description.finish: Matte ceramic white with surgical-grade precision — the finish is almost sterile in appearance, mimicking pharmaceutical packaging. The nozzle is brushed stainless steel with micro-etching to prevent corrosion from the catalytic compound.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: clinical white with subtle gray gradients. Accent: cold stainless steel nozzle and pressure gauge. A single teal highlight stripe runs vertically — LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS house color — with the corporate phi-symbol (Φ) embossed in microscopic lettering.
physical_description.grip_texture: Smooth, slightly textured silicone grip band in the mid-section for secure handling without glove interference. The grip deliberately avoids any aggressive ergonomic design — it feels like holding a medical device, not a weapon.
distinctive_features: Pressurized gauge window with analog readout on the side — shows internal compound saturation
Recessed safety collar with dual-release mechanism requiring sequential activation
Micro-perforations along the nozzle housing for calibrated dispersal cone control
Serial identifier plate with scrambled alphanumeric code and batch designation
Hairline fractalization pattern visible under magnification on the canister surface — signature of the catalytic nano-droplet suspension within
Faint phosphorescent trace elements that glow under UV light (manufacturer tracking feature, not visible to naked eye)
Minute scoring marks on the base suggesting field modification and operator customization
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS corporate logotype embossed subtly on the upper third. Below: 'ATMOSPHERIC REMEDIATION COMPOUND — RESEARCH USE ONLY' in microscopically small text. A teal Φ symbol centered on the pressure gauge. Internal serial plate visible only if the canister is disassembled — intentionally obscured from casual inspection.
physical_description.condition_typical: Immaculate and pristine — the clinical white finish is maintained religiously by operators, as any contamination or corrosion could compromise the pressure seal. The device is treated like a vial in a biosecurity lab rather than a field weapon. Signs of actual deployment are virtually undetectable.

image_prompt: Product photography: VACC-6 catalytic charge canister centered on a black matte surface, slight angle to show the pressurized gauge window and nozzle detail. Dramatic side-lighting from cool-toned LED source casting sharp shadows that emphasize the cylinder's precision engineering. Gloved hand (chrome-knuckled tactical glove) holding the device at mid-grip, fingers relaxed. Extreme close-up on the pressure gauge showing internal compound saturation at 89%. Shallow depth of field with the gauge in sharp focus. Matte white and stainless steel surfaces catch light with pharmaceutical sterility. Teal Φ accent barely visible in ambient light. Cold, clinical, slightly sinister — the aesthetic of something designed to look harmless but operate lethally. Dark laboratory or secure storage background. Cyberpunk noir lighting. --ar 3:2 --v 6
